Hi Amit and Jillian —

Thanks for taking a look at the listing draft last week. We're aiming to get Evergreen Health into the AWS co-sell catalog before the end of May, and wanted to align quickly on two things:

1) AWS marketplace listing checklist: Lauren-legal asked for a short checkpoint to confirm the listing metadata and procurement SKUs are aligned with Evergreen's purchasing flow. I attached our marketplace listing checklist (redwood_marketplace_listing_checklist.pdf).

2) Security gate for co-sell: Evergreen's InfoSec team will need a SOC2 summary plus a short questionnaire answered before Legal signs off. I've attached our SOC2 summary and the MA Plan draft (mutual_action_plan_EVH_v1.xlsx). Can Amit confirm what AWS needs from their side (POC, buyer enablement materials, any listing metadata fields that commonly block approvals)?

Proposed next steps: can we do a 30-min checkpoint tomorrow (Wed 4/7) at 10am PT to walk the checklist and capture any blockers? If that works, Kar (cc'd) will send a calendar invite and we'll bring the minimal docs to the call.

Appreciate it — short meeting should get us to a go/no-go for procurement next week.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop

Thanks Lauren — happy to sync. Quick notes before the call:

- AWS marketplace listing: primary blockers are usually procurement SKU mapping (to ensure customers can use existing contracts) and the technical contact for the listing (we need a name/email for go-live).
- Security/materials: the SOC2 summary is good; for co-sell enablement we also ask for a short ‘deploy and support’ statement that clarifies where data is processed and who owns logs. If Redwood can provide that as a 1-paragraph blurb we can attach it to the listing.
- For Evergreen specifically, I'll need a POC to confirm procurement terms — Jillian, can you confirm who owns procurement and if Evergreen requires a pre-approved vendor list?

I can do the checkpoint tomorrow 4/7 at 10am PT. Sending a quick calendar invite now.

—Amit
Amit Rao

Hi Lauren / Amit —

Thanks for looping me in. I'm Evergreen's Sr. Procurement Manager. Quick answers:

- We do require vendors to be on our pre-approved supplier list — I can submit the vendor intake once we have the SOC2 summary and a short support/deployment blurb.
- Regarding procurement SKUs: Evergreen uses contract-based purchasing; we prefer a Marketplace contract that maps to our standard PO terms. I will need a draft SKU mapping or PO flow chart to review.

Tomorrow 10am PT works. I'll have one of our InfoSec engineers (Carlos) on the call to confirm the security checklist items.

Best,
Jillian Hart
Sr. Procurement Manager | Evergreen Health
